style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Bauble Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Add a touch of refined festive magic to your home with this 41cm artificial bauble wreath in green & bronze. This beautifully balanced wreath blends deep forest greens with rich bronze tones, creating a warm and sophisticated palette that’s perfect for the festive season. Featuring a mix of glossy, matte, and metallic-finish baubles, the wreath catches the light just right—bringing depth, texture, and understated sparkle to any space. Whether it’s welcoming guests at your front door or adding a luxurious accent to your mantel or dining table, this wreath brings festive charm with a modern twist. For those who love their festive décor with a touch of class, this wreath is a stunning blend of tradition and trend. Wreath width: D41cm. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
